name: Active window
description: Title of the focused window, its head and tail kept around a middle ellipsis; takes no room without one or in a vertical bar. A left click focuses it, a middle or right click closes it. Adopted from the owner's t1nk33r.active-window; off by default

maxChars.description: Characters shown at most, the ellipsis included (at least 3)

maxWidth.description: Pixel clamp for a narrow bar, with an end ellipsis (0 = none)
